problem: Which of the following describes the level surfaces of the function $f(x,y,z)=\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}+{z}^{2})?$

choices.value: A family of spheres centered at $(0,0,{e}^{c})$
A family of spheres centered at the origin
A family of surfaces given by ${z}^{2}+c=\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+{y}^{2})$
A family of spheres centered at $(0,0,{e}^{-c})$
A family of surfaces given by ${z}^{2}+c={e}^{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}$
